sup:70510.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor [n8515] (1)
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kw motor.
Our latest forecast for part:350011 grows +11.9% (fc:350011@2026-09).
We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.
We commit to a binding volume of 6,110 pcs per year over 12 months.
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,
Thank you for your e-mail, which we have reviewed internally.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €373.13 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel.
For your information:
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We acknowledge your updated volume forecast and have factored this positive development into our revised calculation.
While you mentioned paying faster to support a better price, your term sheet requested 90 days; we propose maintaining our standard 30-day terms to provide you with a more favorable rate.
Consequently, we can offer a revised unit price of €369.02.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: €369.02 per unit.
Should you require further information, please let us know.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

Dear Sir or Madam,
Thank you for your message.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €372.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel.
For your information:
We acknowledge your revised offer and the binding volume commitment of 6,110 pieces.
To accommodate your stated preference to pay faster in exchange for a better price, we have adjusted the payment terms to 30 days.
This adjustment allows us to offer a more favorable unit price of €368.50.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: €368.50 per unit.
Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.
A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.
Which volume can you commit to?
Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.
This offer is subject to our general terms of sale.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

We have reviewed your alternative proposals and agree to implement the CU-NOTATION, which removes the material risk from our base calculation. We have already taken that volume change data into account.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
